tools.name: fetchDocChunks
tools.description: Fetch related doc chunks using keywords or questions. This tool will return the most relevant chunks of documentation based on the input query.

query.description: The keywords or question to search for

limit.description: The number of chunks to retrieve (default: 10)

tools.name: getCurrentPage
tools.description: Describe the page the user is currently viewing on intlayer.org: URL, title, locale and the locales the site is available in.

tools.name: getDocBySlug
tools.description: Get an array of docs by their slugs. If not slug is provided, return all docs (1.2Mb). List all docs metadata first to get more details about what doc to retrieve.

slug.description: Slug of the docs. If not provided, return all docs. If not provided, return all docs.

strict.description: Strict mode - only return docs that match all slugs, by excluding additional slugs

tools.name: getIntlayerDocumentationPage
tools.description: Fetch a single page of Intlayer's documentation, blog or FAQ as markdown. Accepts a page path such as `/doc/why`, `/doc/concept/cms` or `/blog/intlayer-with-react-i18next`, with or without a locale prefix or `.md` extension.

tools.name: listIntlayerDocumentation
tools.description: List every page of Intlayer's documentation available to agents, as a markdown index of titles and URLs.

tools.name: openPage
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to a page of intlayer.org, given its path (for example `/doc/why`, `/blog`, `/icu-message-formatter`, `/i18n-message-converter`, `/i18n-seo-scanner`). The path is localized to the current locale automatically.

tools.name: searchIntlayerDocumentation
tools.description: Search Intlayer's documentation, blog posts and FAQ by keywords or a question. Returns the most relevant pages with their title, description and path; read a page with `getIntlayerDocumentationPage` or open it with `openPage`.

tools.name: sendUserToAuthentication
tools.description: Send the user to the Intlayer dashboard (app.intlayer.org) to sign in, create an account, or try a read-only demo. An already signed-in user is taken straight to the dashboard. Leaves intlayer.org.

redirectPath.description: Dashboard path to land on once authenticated, such as `/projects` or `/dictionary`.

tools.name: submitWebsiteScanForm
tools.description: Fill the i18n SEO scanner form with a website URL for the user to launch. To run the audit and get the report directly, call `createWebsiteI18nScan` instead.

tools.name: updateLocale
tools.description: Switch the language of intlayer.org for the current page and the rest of the visit.
